entries.back_en: I saw... I could see thousands of eyes in the shadows, looking at me and then... just darkness. I can't explain it... You feel as if an overwhelming force takes hold from within and, when it's done, you stop resisting because now it's part of you...
A Valkyrie was infected?
Save your strength, wise one. She removed the parasite by herself, right before my eyes, and nothing happened.
And, believe it or not, the person responsible for his condition is the same one causing these earthquakes.
They say a great wizard called Baydral cursed the entire planet, which for centuries was in constant war between rival clans over their sea domains.
This curse meant that if a saltwater Fise came into contact with areas predominantly of freshwater, or vice versa, they would transform into a vacant monster we call braj.
You can imagine the rest. The water on Terragaya had no effect on us... or at least it didn't until a few weeks ago. Our people began to turn into monsters, one of them being our friend.
Baydral is on Terragaya! When we found out he was one of Hafin's founders, we travelled here from the Land of the Waterfalls, where many of us Fise settled upon reaching this world.
Unfortunately, our encounter didn't go as planned. We thought we'd meet what our people see as a legend, but what we found... was more of a... a...
entries.note: 'era mais de um' is grammatically wrong; should be 'era mais um...' or 'era mais como um...'.

entries.back_en: Doing this gave us two problems: First, we're not from here, so surely no one would give us the key to open this door. Second, it seems the inside is full of freshwater. Even if we could open it, we couldn't go inside without becoming braj.
entries.note: Grammar error 'sem nos tornamos' should be 'sem nos tornarmos'.

entries.back_en: If you can get hold of the treatment plant key, we can ask Baydral to help us and, at the same time, you can find out what's causing these tremors and stop them. It's advantageous for both sides.
My friend! How's it going?
So, you've been tasked with finding out what's causing these earthquakes? How could you think of going down there without the help of your best friend?
Of course I'm talking about myself!
I call them pig bombs. Set them on the ground and they run like a piglet in a swamp. They're so cute... They remind me of little Balofina. They can even climb up walls!
Well, that's everything I can do for you now. Good luck with those earthquakes. To be honest, at first I thought it was my stomach.
Baiyu, you seem to be brilliant at stating the obvious. I was just getting to that.
If you're showing yourself around Hafin, it must be for something important. What's going on?
Alright... It's true that I haven't recovered my strength after using so much energy.
I understand now... The power they grant makes you want even more.
Just what I thought. Humans. You've always been my favourites!
Worse still, despite listening to us, he ignored our request and locked himself away in this sort of bunker.
Chief, I think we have company.
Huh?
I warned you.
